runs.name: Nintendo Co., Ltd.
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Resumed: the 22:46 cycle copied the template and was stopped by a session limit before any fetch; the 23:46 cycle dispatched one analyst to resume the same file. Price **¥8,146** (TSE 7974, close 2026-10-09; 2026-10-12 a Tokyo holiday) and ADS **$12.99** (close 2026-10-12), Yahoo Finance, aggregator, flagged; **1 ADS = 1/4 share** on Citibank's F-6EF (filed 2022-09-27, accession 0001193805-22-001309). Shares **1,152,828,705** (1,287,260,000 issued less 134,431,295 treasury at 2026-03-31, Annual Report 2026; checked against the filed net assets per share; no dilutive shares) = cap **¥9,390.9bn** (about $59.4bn); sovereign **4.085%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-09). Not an SEC registrant (`cover_shares.py` and `run.py` refuse it): every figure by hand from the Annual Report 2026 (English translation of the Annual Securities Report, fiscal year ended 2026-03-31, issued 2026-06-25), the Annual Reports 2012 to 2025 and the Q1 FY2027 release of 2026-08-06. Not read: the corporate-governance section and directors' pay, the subject of the FY2026 ¥6.4bn litigation loss, The Pokémon Company's accounts. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's Description of business, Management policy, Risk factors and Management's analysis, as the overnight brief directs. A 10-for-1 split effective 2022-10-01. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: one segment, dedicated video game platforms 96.8% of FY2026 sales; the ten-year economics turn on the adoption of each new platform: operating profit ¥487, 555, 357, 171bn in the Wii/DS years (FY2008-11), ¥(37), (36), (46), 25, 33, 29bn in the 3DS/Wii U years (FY2012-17) on the same characters and a debt-free balance sheet, ¥178bn to ¥641bn in the Switch years (FY2018-25), ¥360bn in the Switch 2 launch year; owner cash ran from minus ¥80.6bn to ¥477.7bn over the fourteen years read; every report from 2017 to 2026 declines 'any specific management index targets' because entertainment products 'naturally hold many uncertainties', and the risk factors name technology the company 'may not be able to readily acquire'. The case for IN (forty-year characters, the consumer-business and share-of-mind readings) written first and found not to carry the cash through a failed platform. NATURE, no research pass. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, recorded not weighed: no competitor named in the report (no comparison run); no borrowings, leases ¥7.5bn, net cash and securities ¥2,352bn (¥2,040 a share, about a quarter of the price); inventory ¥39bn (2017) to ¥540bn (2026) with the platform; a one-year earnings forecast published (FY2027 operating profit ¥370bn), carried to Q5 unweighed; dividend policy the higher of 40% of operating profit or a 60% payout; 11.43m shares bought 2026-03-03/04 at an average ¥8,742 under a resolution capping shares and yen but setting no price, and cancelled; IEEPA tariffs in FY2026 cost of sales refunded after the year. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash before interest after tax at the statutory rate (a CONVENTION of this run: reported tax includes untaxed equity-method income), all capital spending and working capital deducted; base the Switch cycle FY2018-25 drawn at the platform boundaries (a CONVENTION of this run), average **¥253.2bn** (literal window FY2022-26 ¥262.8bn); cycle-to-cycle growth 81.2% on the near-zero Wii U base, cut by (f) and capped at the sovereign 4.085%; associates counted at their dividends (about nil); **range ¥7,418 to ¥9,614 a share** ($11.73 to $15.21 an ADS) against ¥8,146; floor tested first: 3.6% to 5.0% at the price, below ten percent on every case; fair price beneath the stop **¥4,591 all-equity** ($7.26 an ADS), ¥2,827 equity-only (no net cash added); not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets 2017-26: no borrowings any year, equity ¥1.49tn to ¥2.98tn built from retained earnings, almost no goodwill. Contamination declared by the analyst: the earlier session's notes recorded the file name '2026-07-14 Test Run - SONY, TBTC, NTDOY.md' in a listing (not opened), JAPAY commit subjects, other research-folder names in a git status listing, memory-index lines naming no position in this company; none used. Commits d5bce25c, c4b89f08, 71d78ad2. Citations: the analyst's check PASS (30 ids, 0 problems); the dispatcher's adjacency script 30 distinct ids resolved, 0 E-ids, 15 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) specific (a) assumes a cycle drawn at owner-cash peaks or troughs; for a platform business the natural cycle is the platform's life and the trough falls in the pre-launch year, and the two give different bases; (2) no rule for growth between cycles when the earlier cycle averaged near zero: (b)'s halves fallback is written for a sign change, so (f) was applied, and the text does not say which governs; (3) Q7 Whose tax gives no instruction where reported tax is struck on a profit including large untaxed equity-method income and interest; (4) the template's accession line cannot be met by a non-SEC filer.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): one segment, dedicated video game platforms; the ten-year economics turn on whether each new platform is adopted: operating profit ¥555bn (FY2009, Wii), three losses to ¥(46)bn (FY2012-14, Wii U, same characters, no debt), ¥641bn (FY2021, Switch), ¥283bn (FY2025), ¥360bn (FY2026, Switch 2 launch); the company itself sets no management targets because its products 'naturally hold many uncertainties' and writes down one year only. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash average ¥253.2bn over the Switch cycle, growth capped at the 4.085% JGB, net cash ¥2,040 a share, range ¥7,418 to ¥9,614 against ¥8,146, 3.6% to 5.0% at the price, fair ¥4,591 all-equity (¥2,827 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: no borrowings in any year; a ¥100bn buyback in March 2026 at ¥8,742 with no price limit; a one-year earnings forecast published, carried to Q5 unweighed.
